translation: One name, the ghost gate (鬼門), is the gate of the dark and hidden. One name, the mysterious mansion (玄府), is the mansion of the mysterious and subtle. Now the mysterious mansion is present in nothing that is not; in the human viscera and bowels, skin and body hair, flesh and muscles, sinews and membranes, bone marrow, nails and teeth, and even in the myriad things, all have it.
translator_notes: 鬼門/玄府 rendered as ghost gate/mysterious mansion with characters.
